title: Little Birdie
description: Little Birdie its a mod based on the minigame and mechanics of the game "The Rag Gang" from the SCG4 event by Eufonia Studios.
body:
# 🦜 Little Birdie

A memory minigame for servers inspired by Eufonia Studios' Squid Craft Games 4.

![Minigame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57794198ac12257cb0fae136afcf4620d92b17a3.png)

An animated parakeet shows you a sequence of colors and movements... and you have to repeat it before time runs out.

Miss a color → lose a life. Run out of lives → you die. Survive all the rounds and you win.

![Game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f381535b7a6a99632da0e6b65aab8a02a43e17a4.png)

You can play alone or with friends at the same time; everyone competes on their own screen, and the server keeps track of who’s passing each round.

---

## How to Use It

First, place the little bird in your world with:
```
/periquito añadir
```

Then build a track using the **Disco Floor** block (found in the creative inventory). When you’re ready, start the game with:
```
/periquito iniciar @a 3 5
```
This starts the game for all players (`@a`), with 3 rounds and sequences of 5 colors. You can change those numbers however you like—up to 10 rounds and 7 colors per sequence.

To change the visual effect of the dance floor, stand on it and type:
```
/periquito piso 3
```
There are 10 different effects to choose from (1 through 10).

> These commands require operator privileges on the server.~~~~
